title: Packaging+GitLab CI: Move debian to the packaging directory.
description:
We keep our various packaging assets in the "packaging" directory. Move
the Debian assets there.

notes.body: dpkg-buildpackage doesn't seem appear to have a "debian directory path" option, but symlinking worked in my test container.

commits_data.title: Packaging+GitLab CI: Move debian to the packaging directory.
commits_data.message:
Packaging+GitLab CI: Move debian to the packaging directory.

We keep our various packaging assets in the "packaging" directory. Move
the Debian assets there. dpkg-buildpackage doesn't seem appear to have a
"debian directory path" option, but symlinking worked in my test
container.
